Officer's narrative
Officer's narrative: On arrival at the intersection in League City, Texas, I found a rear-end collision involving two
passenger vehicles. Driver 1 was stopped in the travel lane when the vehicle operated by Driver 2 struck the rear
bumper area. Driver 1 reported pain in the left wrist and was transported for evaluation. The injury reported is
consistent with the force and direction of the impact, and the damage to the rear of Driver 1's vehicle matches the
described collision. Officers on scene confirmed Driver 1 was inside the vehicle at the time of impact, and a
Passenger was also present in the front seat. No prior damage to Driver 1's vehicle was known or observed. Scene
photographs document some of the reported details. No independent witnesses were located. Driver 1 is listed as the
named insured on the policy covering the vehicle. Vehicles were moved to the shoulder, and traffic was directed until
the scene was cleared.
</page>

injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
